difficulty_reason: Prove 0 -> Pic(T) -> Pic(X_T) -> Picardfunctor_{X/S}(T) is exact when O_T = f_{T,*}O_{X_T} for all T: for injectivity, if f^*N = O_X then f_*f^*N = f_*O_X = O_S and the unit N -> f_*f^*N is locally an isomorphism (locally trivial N), hence an isomorphism globally, so N is trivial; for exactness at Pic(X_T), take L trivialized by sections s_i over an fppf covering {S_i -> S}; the differences pr_0^*s_i vs pr_1^*s_j are units f_ij which, by the pushforward assumption, are units on S_i x_S S_j; the cocycle condition on triple overlaps gives a descent datum, and fpqc descent produces N on S with f^*N = L (full faithfulness of descent for modules).
